items.text: Cardinals trading Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans (MHJ + 7th for 2nd + 6th); was not expected to play for ARI.
items.why: Rapoport/Schefter blockbuster report; ETR not expected.
items.implication: New team boost ROS for MHJ with Nico Collins; ARI WR void.
items.opportunity: Immediate WR help in HOU; fresh start.

items.text: David Montgomery downgraded to OUT with groin injury.
items.why: Schefter downgrade; Rapoport earlier Q; ETR watching.
items.opportunity: Increased role for HOU other RBs.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty will play/active after GTD/plantar fasciitis/ankle.
items.why: ETR final update; Rapoport confirmed go after pregame workout.
items.implication: Start as lead RB if healthy enough.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase will play in Week 5 after prior uncertainty/questionable status.
items.why: ETR final updates and weekend reports; will play confirmed.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; full role expected.
items.opportunity: Normal high target/route share in CIN offense.

items.text: Tee Higgins will play in Week 5.
items.why: ETR updates confirm will play alongside Chase.
items.implication: Viable WR2/flex with Chase also active.
items.opportunity: Shared targets but high volume potential.

items.text: Justin Jefferson expected/active to play; Jordan Addison not expected/inactive.
items.why: ETR GTD to expected play for Jefferson, Addison not expected; Schefter confirmed actives/inactives.
items.implication: Jefferson full start; Addison sit, boosts Jefferson/others.

items.text: Deebo Samuel out for remainder of game with hamstring.
items.why: Schefter mid-game; Rapoport confirmed ruled out.
items.implication: Monitor for next week; short-term sit.
items.opportunity: Boost to other SF WRs/TEs in remaining snaps.

items.text: Jaylen Warren should be workhorse with Rico Dowdle out; passes advanced stats/eye test, Austin Ekeler-esque; coaching staffs refuse full role but opportunity now.
items.why: Levitan player-specific: Dowdle out opens path; high praise on metrics.
items.implication: Strong RB start/upgrade ROS if role sticks.
items.conflict: Prior coaching reluctance to feature solely.

items.text: Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (prior not expected).
items.why: Schefter report; ETR had not expected.
items.implication: Avoid or bench; low snap risk.
items.opportunity: Opens more for other LAC WRs like Quentin Johnston.

items.why: ETR final; Schefter listed among actives.
items.implication: Start as WR1 for WAS with Daniels return.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs only 61.5% owned in DK single-entry double-ups; strong cash play value highlighted in postgame review.
items.why: Levitan DFS cash review: undersowned relative to production/role.
items.implication: Strong play in all formats; leverage.

items.why: Schefter on Ravens inactives; ETR expected.
items.opportunity: Primary WR with Huntley at QB.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.why: Berry notes widespread waiver heat post-performance.
items.implication: Priority add for GB RB depth/upside.

items.text: George Kittle officially active despite illness.
